trial-of-joan-of-arc-rouen.description: A dim, painterly interior of a stone medieval hall with pointed arches and shafts of light from high windows. A young woman with short dark hair, in a dark tunic and wrists in chains, stands centre-right in a beam of light. On the left, clerics in black hooded robes sit at a wooden table with open books, scrolls, a quill and an inkwell, and one points. An armoured soldier stands at the right edge among onlookers. No visible text, frame or border.

trial-of-sir-thomas-more.description: Interior of a large timber-roofed hall with arched stone windows and tiered wooden galleries where men in black caps and fur-trimmed red and black robes sit. In the foreground an old bearded man in a plain dark gown leans on a wooden staff, looking up. A shadowy figure stands at left, a clerk writes at a desk at lower right, and candles stand on posts. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

charles-i-put-on-trial.description: A bearded man in a tall black hat and black cloak with a white collar and a star-shaped order on his chest sits in a red velvet chair in the foreground, holding a silver-topped cane and a folded paper. Behind him, a guard with a halberd stands in the shadows. Tiers of seated men in black caps and black gowns look on from wooden benches in a dim, vaulted hall lit by a shaft of light from above. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text, border or wall.

zenger-libel-acquittal.description: An older man with a white wig and dark coat stands at right, one hand raised mid-gesture, facing a crowd of men in tricorn hats and dark coats packed behind a wooden rail in a panelled hall with tall arched windows. A younger man in a white shirt leans on the rail at centre, looking up. A clerk sits at a desk at right with papers and an inkwell, and two robed figures sit on a bench in the background. Warm brown, oil-painted look, with scattered paper on the floor.

boston-massacre-soldiers-trial.description: A candlelit wooden courtroom with a man in a black coat and grey wig gesturing toward a bench, with a paper in one hand. Two rows of soldiers in red coats sit on benches at left and right, heads bowed. Townspeople in dark 18th-century clothes sit or stand in the crowd behind, and two wigged judges sit at the upper right beside a window. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

amistad-supreme-court-ruling.description: A painted courtroom scene. An elderly bald man with glasses, in a black coat, points with one hand and holds a rolled paper in the other, facing a row of older men in black robes seated at a curved wooden bench on the right. On the left, a group of Black men and women in worn, plain clothing sit and watch. The room has a stone arched ceiling, brick walls, a glowing window, gas wall lamps and a gallery of standing spectators. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.

john-brown-trial-harpers-ferry.description: An elderly man with a long white beard and white hair lies on a wooden cot under a white pillow, wrapped in a dark blanket, in a wood-paneled room. Armed men in dark 19th-century uniforms hold rifles upright around the bed, and a crowd of men in frock coats and top hats stands behind them, with a small table and papers at right. Light comes through tall windows at upper left. The style is an oil-like painting with no visible text, no frame, and no visible blood or wounds.

oscar-wilde-trials.description: A man with shoulder-length wavy hair, in a dark frock coat with a white collar and a flower in his lapel, leans on a wooden rail in the foreground. Behind him, a judge in a white wig and black robe sits on a raised bench at upper right, and spectators sit in a dim, wood-paneled room. The style is a dark, painterly oil look, and the painting appears to run edge to edge. I see no visible text.

sacco-vanzetti-convicted.description: A steel-mesh cage with two wooden chairs inside stands on a dark wooden floor in a wood-paneled room with tall multi-pane windows. Blurred figures, seen as a crowd, are visible through the windows at left. Warm sunlight falls across the scene. No people are inside the cage, and there is no visible text.

al-capone-tax-evasion-conviction.description: A dark, painterly wood-panelled courtroom interior. On a worn wooden table sit stacks of old ledger books and loose papers, an inkwell with a pen, and a black fedora-style hat resting on top of a book. Behind the table are empty wooden benches and a judge's bench near a window with soft light. No people are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge.

us-v-nixon-supreme-court.description: Cardboard boxes, some open and torn, are heaped on the steps of a building with massive fluted columns. The boxes hold metal reels wound with dark film or tape, and loose reels and trailing tape lie on the stone steps in the foreground. The scene is dark and painterly, with no people, no visible text and no frame.

rodney-king-officers-acquitted.description: A wood-paneled courtroom interior with no people: rows of dark wooden swivel chairs, a counsel table with a legal pad, a pen and a crumpled paper ball. Through a large multi-pane window, a city skyline sits under a column of black smoke rising from the right. Painterly oil style, dim interior lit from the window.

bush-v-gore-ruling.description: A weathered hand holds up a punched card or paper strip with rectangular holes, lit from behind by a warm lamp glow in a dark room. Some small bits of paper flutter around it. Behind the hand is a stack of papers tied with string, and on the desk lie a magnifying glass and a brass lamp base. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text and no frame.

depp-v-heard-verdict.description: Oil-style painting of a modern wood-panelled courtroom. A broadcast video camera on a tripod dominates the foreground; behind it a gallery of spectators holds up glowing phones. A wooden lectern with a microphone, a judge's bench and chair, a monitor and papers, and a round state seal on the back wall. No frame, border, signature, blood or nudity. The seal's rim has only tiny painterly marks, not readable text.
